key_features.classic_presentation: ONSET: Intermittent, episodic. LOCATION: Chest, precordial area. DURATION: Brief, seconds per episode. CHARACTER: "Skipped beat", "flip-flop", brief flutter or pause. AGGRAVATING: Caffeine, alcohol, stress, fatigue, lack of sleep. RELIEVING: Relaxation, reducing stimulants. TIMING: Intermittent, random. SEVERITY: Mild discomfort, more bothersome than painful. KEY POSITIVES: Brief episodes, no syncope, no dyspnea, otherwise healthy, triggered by caffeine or stress. KEY NEGATIVES: NO sustained rapid heart rate, NO syncope, NO chest pain, NO dyspnea.

red_flags: Family history of sudden cardiac death
